title: Puke
original_lyrics:
[intro]
N..
There I go, thinkin' of you again
You don't know how sick you make me
You make me fuckin' sick to my stomach
Every time I think of you I puke
You must just not know whoa whoa
You may not think you do but you do
Every time I think of you I puke

[verse]
I was gonna take the time to sit down and write you little poem

[bridge]
I got million reasons off the top of my head that I could think of
Sixteen bars just ain't enough to put some ink to so fuck it I'm start right here and just be brief
About to rattle off some other reasons
I knew I shouldn't go and get another tattoo
Of you on my arm, but what do I go and do?
I go and get another one, now I got two ohh-ohh-ooh-ooh-ooh
Now I'm sittin' here with your name on my skin
I can't believe I went and did this stupid shit again
My next girlfriend, now her name's gotta be Kim sh-i-i-i-it
If you only knew how much I hated you

You don't know how sick you make me
You make me fuckin' sick to my stomach
Every time I think of you I puke
You must just not know whoa whoa
You may not think you do but you do
Every time I think of you I puke

[verse]
I was gonna take the time to sit down and write you little letter

[bridge]
that you' probably just shredder, yeah
I stumbled on your picture yesterday and made me stop and think of
How much of waste it' be for me to put some ink to
stupid piece of paper, I' rather let you see how
Much I fuckin' hate you in freestyle
You're fuckin' coke-head and I hope you fuckin' die
I hope you get to hell and Satan sticks needle in your eye
I hate your fuckin' guts you fuckin' slut I hope you die, -i-i-i-i-

[bridge]
It's not that I still love you its not cause I want you back
It's just that when I think of you it makes me want to hack, ha---ack

[bridge]
Now I guess I'll just move on I have no choice but to
